༄༅/ /dpal mkha' 'gro snyan rgyud lus dkyil gyi dmigs rim mdor bsdus pa'i reg zig go/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// dpal mkha' 'gro snyan rgyud lus dkyil gyi dmigs rim mdor bsdus pa'i reg zig go /

"$ ༄༅// bla ma dang dpal bde mchog 'khor lo rnam dbyer med pa la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dir snyan rgyud yab bka' lus dkyil gyi dmigs rim mdor bsdus shig bri bar bya'o// de la bde mchog phyi dkyil dang lus dkyil 'di nyid du dbang thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pas gdod nas grub pa'i dur khrod la sogs pa'i gnas su bsgom par bya ba la/ sngon dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po ni phyogs bcu'i zhing bzhugs kyi mchog gsum rtsa gsum la dmigs nas/ phyogs bcur bzhugs pas skyabs 'gro/ ji ltar dus gsum gyis sems bskyed/ de nas rdor sems sam/ bde mchog gam/ khaṇḍa ro he ma lta bu bskyed bzlas 'od zhur sgrub pa'i chus phyi khrus/ rdo rje'i chu 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs pas nang khrus// rdor sems sgom bzlas kyis gsang khrus nas/ rang rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i spyi bo na yar rtsa brgyud bla ma gsal btab nas/ rdo rje 'chang chen rnal 'byor ma zhes sogs kyis gsol 'debs byas mthar brgyud bla rnams rtsa ba'i bla mar bstim nas/ de nyid la sku yi byin rlabs lus la zhugs sogs kyis dbang bzhi len dus spyi mgrin snying lte nas 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum 'phros pa sgo gsum la rim par thim pas so so'i dri ma dag bum gsang sher gsum gyi dbang thob/ 'bras bu rdo rje gsum grub skal bzhag par bsam/ mthar bla ma 'od du zhu rang la 'dres pas sgo gsum tha dad du 'dzin pa'i dri ma dag bzhi pa'i dbang thob/ ye shes rdo rje grub skal bzhag par bsam/ yang na bla ma 'od du zhu ba'i sku'i byin rlabs lus/ gsung ngag yid thugs/ ye shes sgo gsum thun mong ngam rnam shes kyi khams la chu rgyun gyi rim pa ltar zhugs pas sgrib bzhi sbyangs pa dbang bzhi thob pa sogs mos sbyor ni dbang bzhi chu rgyun gcig ma zhes bya ste dmigs pa 'di ltar na dbang bzhi len tshig logs su mi 'don par brgyud 'debs rjes rang du rtsa ba'i bla ma bstim pa la de ltar dmigs pas chog go

/de ltar bstim pa'i mnyam bzhag las bde mchog zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa yab rkyang du langs te/ rang gnas sa nas brtsams sa phyogs thams cad bde chen gyi rang gdangs rnam bcas sgyu 'phrul gyi rang bzhin mkha' 'gro mngon par 'du zhing spyod pa dur khrod kyi dkyil 'khor du shar ba dang*/ rang gi stan du dmigs med bde ba mtshon pa'i ro stan dang*/ g.yon phyogs su phag mo'i rang bzhin phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa'i rig ma mtshan ldan/ bdag nyid he ru ka'i skur yang phyin drug dag pa'i phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa rnams kyi mos pa byas nas/ bdud rtsi ril bu btab pa'i nang mchod byin gyis brlabs pa mtheb srin sbyar bas yab yum mnyam sbyor las byang sems dkar dmar babs pas lce mgrin nas brtsams te lus thams cad bde bas gang rlung thams cad ye shes kyi rlung du dag par bsam/ bdud rtsi byin rlabs kyang rgyas par snyan rgyud lhan skyes sgrub thabs kun mkhyen chen pos mdzad pa las/ swa bhā wa nas bdud rtsi dang gnyis su med par gyur zhes pa'i bar len cing*/ yang lhan cig skyes ma'i sgrub thams cad kyi ltar yang rung la/ de ltar na snying ga'i baṃ gyi 'od ces pa'i tshab tu snying ga'i hūm̐ zhes 'jug rang yab rkyang gi snying gar hūm̐ yig phral der sgom dgos so// dngos gzhi la/ srung 'khor/ bsod nams tshogs bsags/ tshad med/ ye shes tshogs/ rten dkyil 'khor/ brten pa lha lnga/ lus dkyil gsal 'debs/ go bgo ye shes dgug pa/ dbang*/ rdor bzlas/ rdzogs rim ste bcu gnyis so// de nas dang po'i skabs/ 'bru gsum brjod pas rang nyid bde mchog yab rkyang du gsal ba de 'od du zhu nas oṃ dkar/ āḥdamar/ hūm̐ sngon po rnams steng nas steng du brtsegs pa gsal btab pa'i/ oṃ āḥ.āḥhūm̐ la thim/ hūm̐ yang zhabs kyu nas nā da'i bar dang*/ de yang mi par dmigs gyur pa dang lhan cig shrī ni gnyis med ye shes te sogs yi ge bzhi'i don dran pas mnyam par 'jog pa'i don ni/

shrīs mtshon pa gnyis su med pa'i ye shes de thog mar skye ba'i rgyus stong*/ bar du rang gi ngo bo gnas pas stong*/ mthar 'gag pa'i 'bras bus stong pa ste/ de lta bu nga'o snyam pa'i nga rgyal gyis so// de las skad cig gis bde mchog dpa' bo gcig pa'i skur ldang ba ste/ 'bru gsum brjod pa dang dmigs pa/ ye shes bzhi'i don la mnyam par 'jog pa/ lhar gsal ba ste rim bzhin ngag yid lus dag pa sgo gsum dag byed kyi rnal 'byor ro// lhar gsal ba'i snying khar sna tshogs padma dang zla ba la hūm̐ yig mthing nag yig bdun mthing gas g.yas su 'khor bas bskor ba/ de'i 'od zer mthing nag cher 'phro zhing 'bar ba'i klong nas kha dog sna tshogs pa'i rdo rje dpag med spros pa rnams steng 'og phyogs mtshams su 'dus shing 'brel bar gyur pa las/ 'og tu rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ thad kar ra ba zlum po/ steng du gur dang*/ ra bar gyi nang gnam rgyan lta bur bla bre/ de rnams kyi phyi steng log khebs par rdo rje mda'i drā ba rnams su gyur par bsam/ de nas snying kha'i hūm̐ yig las 'od zer dmar ngam che zhing tsha ba 'phros pa'i sna la sgo mtshams kyi khro mo brgyad po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa g.yas gnyis na rdo rje tho ba dang zhags pa/ g.yon gnyis na phur pa dang lcags kyu bsnams pa stag sham can shin tu che zhing 'jigs pa'i skur spros pa phyogs mtshams brgyad du phyir bltas te 'khod pa'i sku mdog phyogs mthun te khwa gdong ma nag mo nas gshin rje 'joms ma g.yas ljang g.yon sngo ba'i bar ro// de ltar spros te 'khod pa la oṃ hrīḥsogs kyis bka' bsgos pas/ lha mo rnams kyis rang 'dra dpag tu med pa spros pas bgegs rnams zhags pas bcings/ lcags kyus phug ste drangs nas sprul gzhi rang rang gi mdun du dor ba la/ phur pas btab cing rdo rjes brdungs pas phye mar byas nas sprul pa rnams sprul gzhi la thim pas de dag kyang me 'od kyi phreng bar gyur pas rdo rje'i gur khang kun nas dkris shing 'bar bar bsam mo// 'dir steng gi bgegs gzhom pa la shar gyi shar du khwa gdong ma gnyis pa dang*/

'og gi bgegs la nub kyi nub tu khyi gdong ma gnyis pa spro yang rnam pa 'dra bas brgyad por 'du'o// gnyis pa bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa ni/ snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer sngon po'am sna tshogs pa lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pas/ sku gsung thugs bde chen dam tshig ste 'khor lo lnga yongs su rdzogs pa'i rten brten pa'i dkyil 'khor sku gsum gyi zhing nas spyan drangs pa mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa la/ na ma sogs brjod pa'i tshe rang gis kyang 'dud pa'i nyams dang*/ lha dang mi mchog mkha' 'gro la sogs pa'i rnam pa du mar sprul pas kyang zhabs la phyag byas par bsam/ tshogs rten gyi steng gi char bla ma sgom pa'am dkyil 'khor gtso bo nyid rtsa ba'i bla ma/ de la brgyud bla sogs skyabs gnas kun 'dus su mos pa gnyis las phyi ma bde'o// snying ga'i sa bon las gzugs ma sogs sde tshan re re'ang nam mkha' khyab pa tsam du spros pas mchod de/ de la lus kyi gar dang ngag gi glu dbyangs sogs dang mchod rdzas kyi gzigs mos mchod pa phyi mchod de dag la longs spyad pas thugs tshim pa nang mchod/ mthar lha mo rnams dpa' bor rang rang gi yum la thim pas snyoms 'jug gis mchod cing*/ mchod yul lha mo bcu gnyis lta bu yang gtso bo he ru ka'i thugs rgyud la bde chen lhag par bskyed pa'i mdangs kyis shin tu dgyes bder gyur par bsam pa gsang mchod do// de nas lnga rnam dag 'bul ba yang rang lhar gsal ba'i ram 'degs sprul pa phyag byed po rnams kyis byed par bsam/ de nas sprul pa rnams rang la bsdus/ tshogs zhing rang gnas su gshegs par bsam pa ni sngar gang nas byon pa'i gnas su gshegs pa yin la/ 'on kyang bdag nyid la bstim na byin rlabs bzang bar gsungs de ltar mdzad pas na/ rten brten par bcas pa'i 'khor lo de 'od du zhu nas snying gar thim pa'am spyi bo nas bstim pa gang rung ngo*// gsum pa tshad med ni/

thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer dpag med 'phros// sems can gyi khams la phog pas/ de kun sdug bsngal dang bral ba nas/ btang snyoms chen po la gnas gyur gyi bar mos pas/ sems can thams cad sogs brjod/ slar yang sems can thams cad mi zad pa'i sdug bsngal las phyung ste zhes smon sems bskyed/ bzhi pa ye shes kyi tshogs ni/ swa bhā wa'i sngags don la mnyam par 'jog pa ste/ chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa nges pa'i dbyings su'o// lnga pa rten dkyil 'khor ni/ stong pa'i ngang las srung 'khor gyi nang phyi dkar la nang dmar ba yangs shing rgya che ba'i chos 'byung gi lte bar dur khrod brgyad kyis bskor ba'i sna tshogs padma'i dbus rdo rje rgya gram shar rwa dkar ba sogs phyogs mdog can gyi lte bar gzhal med khang pa'i dkyil du sna tshogs padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i dbus dang phyogs bzhi'i lte bar nyi gdan no// drug pa brten pa lha ni/ nyi gdan dbus ma'i steng*/ dbyangs yig gcig rjes su gcig mthud pas/ tshar gnyis g.yon bskor dang*/ de'i nang ngos su gsal byed tshar gnyis g.yas su 'khor ba'i 'khor lo ste/ dbyangs dkar po dang gsal byed dmar po/ de gnyis yongs su gyur pa las dkar la dmar mdangs chags pa'i zla ba'i dbus su hūm̐ yig sngon po 'od lnga 'phro bas snod bcud phral der 'khor lor sbyangs pa dang gdod nas grub pa'i rnal 'byor dang rnal 'byor ma'i dbang phyug rnams spyan drangs te thim pa las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las phyogs bzhir g.yon bskor gyis dkar ljang dmar ser ba'i hūm̐ rnams mched pa dang bcas yongs su gyur pa las lha lnga bskyed cing*/ mtshams 'dab bzhir byang sems kyis gang ba'i thod pa bzhi'am/ yang na tsandan dang dri chen gur gum dri chu rnams kyis gang ba'i bum pa bzhi'i steng du byang sems kyis gang ba'i thod pa bzhi'o// bdun pa lus dkyil gsal 'debs ni/

rkang pa gnyis bgrad pa gzhu'i dbyibs can zhes sogs te lus cha rten dkyil 'khor gyi cha shas de de'i rang bzhin du dag mos tsam gyis chog go /lus dbus su spyi bo nas gsang ba'i bar rtsa dbu ma kha dog sngon po 'od kyi sbu gu'i rnam pa/ snying padma 'dab brgyad du snang ba'i lte ba dbu ma'i nang du tshud cing 'dab ma rnams de'i thad kyi dbu ma las gyes pa 'dra ba dang*/ yum gyi skur yang dbu ma dmar po sgom/ padma'i lte bar nyi gdan la dbyangs tshar gnyis mthud g.yon 'khor dang*/ de'i steng du gsal byed tshar gnyis g.yas su 'khor ba yongs su gyur pa las zla nyi kha sbyor gyi bar du hūm̐ dang āḥyig gi 'od lngas snod bcud sbyangs pa dang gdod nas dag pa'i lha rnams mchod cing bkug ste bstim pas phyag mtshan sa bon gyis mtshan pa sogs rtogs par sla/ yum gyi phyag mtshan la kha ṭwām̐ ga dang thod pas mtshan pa'i phyag g.yon pas yab la 'khyud ces pa las/ phyag mtshan g.yas pa ma byung yang*/ 'di kha'i rgya gzhung du/ rdo rje thod pa bsnams pa ste zhes pa ltar ro// g.yon gyi kha ṭwām̐ ga 'dzin pa ni yig rnying gnyis ka nas ma bshad pas ched du dgos pa med 'dra na/ de dang g.yas pa'i phyag mtshan ma byung ba sogs samaṭar gnang ba lta bu bris nogs la yig mkhan gyis 'ol tshod thal ba'ang min pa'i nges pa mi 'dug mod slar yang brtag go /phyogs 'dabs bzhir mdun nas g.yon bskor gyis lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐ mthing ljang dmar ser las mkha' 'gro ma sogs bzhi dang*/ mtshams 'dabs la bum thod bzhi/ 'tshogs ma la sogs pa'i gnas nyer bzhir pu la sogs pa'i yi ge lha mdog dang mthun pa yongs su gyur pa las thod pa'i dum bu dang rab gtum ma sogs rim pa can dang*/ kha sna la sogs par hūm̐ lha mdog las sgo mtshams ma bskyed de lha mdog dmigs bsal med pa dag drug cu ma bzhin no// gnas ni rab tu dga' ba zhes sogs kyi sa bcu'i rnam dag sgom/

brgyad pa go bgo ba la gtso bo'i snying khar oṃ haḥdakar po yongs su gyur pa las rdor sems sogs dang*/ yum gyi lte bar oṃ bam̐ dmar po las phag mo dmar mo sogs/ de las yab rnams rdor sems nas brtsams rim bzhin phyag g.yas rdo rje 'khor lo/ rin chen/ rdo rje/ padma/ sna tshogs rdo rje/ g.yon de des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pas thugs kar bsnol bstabs/ zhabs g.yas brkyang gom stabs dpa' mo rnams gri gug 'phyar zhing thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin pa/ skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs can te/ rdor sems dang rmongs byed ma zla gdan/ gzhan rnams nyi gdan du sgrub thabs rgyas pa sogs nas bshad pa ltar dang*/ yab rnams thor tshugs can stag sham rgyan drug yum rnams skra grol gcer mo phyag rgya lngas brgyan par nges so// yang yi ge tsam bsgoms nas lhar mos pas kyang rung ste/ de tshe kha dog dang zla nyi'i gdan gyi thob thang sngar bzhin no// dgu pa ye shes dgug pa la/ lus dkyil gyi gtso bo'i thugs kar nyi ma la hūm̐ yig dngul chu lta bu las 'od zer sna lnga lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pas 'og min gyi zhing nas/ phyi dkyil lha lnga gzhal yas khang dur khrod dang bcas pa/ nang lus dkyil du gsal ba bsgoms pa ji lta ba mdun mkhar spyan drangs pa la/ ā darsha nas dharma'i bar gyis mchod pa la/ snying ga nas mchod lha de de mtha' yas par spro zhing*/ slar mkha' 'gro ma dang lā ma sogs yum bzhi phyag gnyis pa ka pā la bdud rtsis gang ba thogs pa hūm̐ yig las spros pas mchod par mos nas/ oṃ sarba pañtsa sogs brjod/ mchod lha rnams yum la thim pas snyoms 'jug gis mchod tshul sngar bzhin byed/ rkang brgyad kyis bstod pa na rang nyid kyis bstod pas brtan g.yo'i sgra tshogs bstod par 'char bar bsam/ bcu pa dbang ni/ rgyas par slob ma dbang skur ji lta ba'i bdag 'jug byed par gsung mod/ rgyun gyi lam dbang ni oṃ sarba sogs kyis dbang bskur bar gsol ba btab pas/

mdun gyi lus dkyil gtso bo yab yum gyis spros pa spyan ma la sogs pa'i ngo bor gzugs can ma sogs snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi dang*/ rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug rnal 'byor mas bum pa ye shes lnga'i bdud rtsis gang bas phyi lha lnga'i spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba'i zhar gyis nang gi lha tshogs la yang dbang bskur ba'i mthar phyi nang gi gtso bo gnyis la mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan cing*/ gzhan phyi nang gi lha kun gyi spyi bor rdo rje'i bsgreng bus mtshan par bsam/ bum dbang la sgrub thabs rnams su de tsam las ma gsal yang gtso bo yab yum gyis yum lnga spros pas dbang bskur/ thod pa'i dum bu sogs dpa' bo nyer bzhi spros pas bkra shis brjod/ rab gtum ma sogs dpa' mo nyer bzhi spros pas mchod pa 'bul/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad spros pas bgegs skrod pa dang*/ gtso bo yab yum nas brtsams phyi nang gi lha spyan drangs pa kun gyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad par mos dgos so// gsang dbang la mdun gyi phyi nang gi lha zung 'jug kun dang*/ sher dbang la bdag bskyed phyi nang kun snyoms zhugs su bsam mod/ phyi'i lha gtso bo nyid la lhag par dmigs nas dga' bzhi ngos 'dzin sogs byed/ mnyam sbyor gyis bskyed pa'i lhan skyes kyi bde ba spros bral du nges pas mnyam par 'jog pa bzhi pa'i dbang ngo*// dza sogs brjod pas mdun dkyil ye shes pa de bdag bskyed dam tshig par bsre ba la phyi nang gi lha dang*/ gzhal yas khang sogs so sor de dang de la thim par bsam pa'am yang na 'khor lo yongs rdzogs snying gar bstim/ gong du dbang skur mkhan gyi lha rnams ni rigs bdag la bstim mo// de nas snying ga'i lha'i thugs srog las phyi mchod kyi lha mo gzugs ma sogs gong bshad ltar ram/ rig ma bcu drug sogs kyang legs la/ nang mchod 'bul ba po snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi rnams spros nas so sor mchod de/

sarba pañtsa sogs brjod cing dngos su bdud rtsi 'thor/ 'di dus mdun mkhar rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong sogs dmigs nas so sor bdud rtsi 'bul ba yang rgyas par ste/ 'bul tshig bde mchog rgyas pa'i mchod do phud thams cad ces sogs lta bu'o// de nas mchod lha rnams yum la thim pa'i snyoms 'jug gis mchod/ rkang brgyad kyis bstod dus dmigs pa sngar ltar/ bcu gcig pa rdor bzlas la/ rlung rdor bzlas ni/ rlung rang bzhin gyis 'jug gnas ldang gsum mam bum can dang sbyar yang legs te/ de la rlung phyir gtong dus yab kyi shangs bug g.yas nas hūm̐ yig mthing ga'i phreng bar thon/ rngub dus yum gyi padma nas zhugs/ dhū ti brgyud shangs g.yas nas yab kyi shangs g.yon du zhugs/ dhū ti nas lte ba tshun 'ongs/ rlung sdom pa na lte bar āḥyig dmar po'i rnam par gnas pa la sems 'dzin/ yang dbyung dus yab kyi shangs g.yas nas hūm̐ gi phreng bar thon pa sogs gong bzhin/ skor 'ded nyer gcig la sogs par sgrub la/ rang bzhin gyis 'jug gnas ldang bar yang des 'gre/ de la hūm̐ gi rnam pas phyir 'gro ba'i tshe yul snang thams cad bde bas khyab/ rngub dus rang lus bde bas gang*/ sdom dus phyi nang thams cad bde ba'i gong bur song bar bsam/ yang khyad par gyi dmigs pa la phyir gtong dus hūm̐ gi 'od kyis yul snang thams cad 'khor lo lnga'i dpa' bo rnal 'byor mar snang ba bde chen gyi rol mo mdzad par dmigs/ rngub dus lus dkyil gyi lha rnams dgyes par spyod pas lus bde bas gang*/ āḥyig la sems 'dzin dus phyi nang gi lha rnams mnyam sbyor mdzad pa'i bde ba sems thog tu gcig pa'i nges pa 'dzin pa ste/ bde chen gyi lha ni don gyi lha yin la/ kun rdzob dbyibs kyi lha tshan tshan so so ba ltar yang bde chen gyi lha la dbye ba med pa nyid rang gis rig cing nyams su myong ba'i tshul 'di ni/

bde mchog gi zab gnas pho nya gsum bsre'i gnad don khyad par can yang yin te/ phyi yul snang zhes pa phyi rol bsam yul du gyur tshad la byed pas/ longs sprul gyi zhing mtha' dag kyang bsdus pa'i phyir/ 'og min gyi lhan skyes dang*/ sprul zhing gi zhing skyes/ lus la sngags kyis bskyed pa sngags skyes rnams kyi thugs rgyud bde chen rang rig gi klong du dbyer med par bsres pas so// 'dir 'bru gsum las rang mdog gam sna lnga pa'i 'od zer 'phro zhing rang sgra sgrog par bsam mo// yang yab kyi rdo rje'i sna rtser thig le dkar po dang*/ yum gyi ze'u 'brur thig le dmar po/ gnyis ka yungs 'bru tsam/ de gnyis phrad pas dmar cha'i drod kyis dkar cha bzhu brtul byed pa'i bde ba dang*/ dmar cha'i 'od zer me'i rang bzhin yab kyi dhū ti nas zhugs/ spyi bor ham̐ yig mgo thur bstan dmigs pa la reg pas byang sems rim par babs nas spyi mgrin snying lte gsang rnams gang zhing*/ yas brten gyi dga' ba skyes pa dang*/ byang sems kyi rgyun sna rtse'i thig le man las mi 'da' zhing*/ slar yum gyi sna rtse'i thig le me'i rnam par 'bar bas byang sems rnams gsang ba nas lte ba dang*/ de nas snying mgrin spyi rnams su rim par bzlog pa la mas brten gyi dga' bzhi'i ngos 'dzin/ mthar me dang byang sems gnyis ka ye shes bde ba chen po'i klong du thim par bsams nas mnyam par 'jog pa ste/ 'di rnams nges par bum can dang sbyor bas/ rlung ro lan gsum bsal rjes nang du rngub dus sna g.yon nas oṃ yig gi rang bzhin gyi rlung 'od zer dkar po'i tshul du byung ba/ dhū ti brgyud/ yab yum gyi sna rtse'i thig le gnyis la thim par mos pas rlung āḥyig gi rang bzhin du gyur par bsams nas sdom/ bzung ring dmar chasadakar cha bzhu brtul byed pa tsam dmigs/ dbyung dus thig le de dag las hūm̐ gi rang bzhin gyi rlung dud sprin lta bu bye ba dhū ti brgyud sna g.yas nas phyir thon pas snang yul khyab ste de kun bde chen du shar bar mos/

rngub dus rlung oṃ gyi rang bzhin 'od zer dkar por rngub pa la snang yul gyi dwangs ma'i bde tshogs 'dus pa sna g.yon nas gong bzhin zhugs gsang thig kha sbyor la thim pas de dag stobs rgyas shing*/ rlung āḥ'i rang bzhin du mos/ dgang ba'i tshe/ dmar cha'i zer dang*/ dkar cha'i bde nyams kyis ham̐ yig skul bas byang sems cung zad 'bebs par bsam/ dbyung dus gsang thig las rlung sngon po hūm̐ gi rang bzhin dhū ti brgyud sna g.yas nas phyir thon pas yul snang bde bar sad/ rngub dus bde ba rlung dang lhan cig drangs pa gsang thig la bstim/ dgang dus me zer dang bde nyams kyis bskul ba'i ham̐ yig bzhu rgyun gyis spyi bo nas mgrin pa'i bar gang bar dmigs nas dga' ba dang po ngos bzung rjes hūm̐ dang oṃ gi rang bzhin du gtong rngub sogs sngar bzhin/ de nas snying ga yan gang ba'i mchog dga'/ lte ba yan gang ba'i khyad dga'/ gsang rtse yan gang ba'i lhan skyes dang*/ slar mes ded tshul gyis lte ba'i bar gshegs pa la dga' ba/ snying mgrin spyi gsum la dga' ba lhag ma bzhi ste re re bzhin bum can re re sbyar nas khyon bsdoms khug bcu gcig 'byung ba'i rigs 'gres mang nyung spel bsdu bya ba ni dga' ba re'i thad du khug pa gsum re tsam sbyor ba dang*/ khug pa rer dga' bzhi'i 'gros re rdzogs par bsgom pa sogs so/ de dag tu yang na ma'i dmigs par rlung dbyung dus hūm̐ gi rang bzhin can dud sprin lta bu des yul snang phyogs cha kun khyab pas/ de kun 'khor lo gsum gyi lha dang rten du snang bar byas pa mnyam sbyor gyi bde ba la dgyes pa dang*/ rngub dus de dag gi thugs rgyud kyi bde tshogs rlung dang 'dres nas gsang thig la thim pa'i zhar la rlung gang nas drangs pa'i lam dhū ti nas brtsams lus cha bde bas khyab pas lus dkyil gyi lha rnams kyang dgyes par bskul ba dang*/

gsang thig gnyis las kyang bde nyams cher longs pa/ dgang dus ni dga' bzhi ngos 'dzin la sogs pa'i tshe phyi nang gnyis su med pa'i bde ba la mnyam par 'jog pa'i tshul te sngar bshad rdor bzlas dang rjes mthun no// yang rlung tshur 'dren dus dhū ti'i lam nas brtsams lus bde bas khyab pa'i mos pa ni snang ba lhar ched sgom med par rang ga bde bar sgom pa'i phyogs la yang dgos shing*/ rdor bzlas 'di dang gong ma gnyis kar yab yum gyi sku'i dbus dbu ma sngo dmar tsam las ro rkyang sogs rtsa gzhan ched du mi sgom yang*/ rlung 'dren dus shangs bug nas smin mtshams bar gyen dang*/ de nas phred la phar dbus su song ba spyi bo'i mdud sgo yod sa'i thad nas dbu mar zhugs pa lta bu yin la/ rdor bzlas gong 'og gnyis kar rlung dbu mar 'gro 'ong byed dus snying ga'i ye shes sems dpa'i gtsug tor gyi rtse nas dbu ma brgyud de zhugs/ sbyor mtshams nas thon pa yang zhar la dmigs dgos so// de la snga ma rdor bzlas kha rkyang dang*/ phyi ma gtum mo rdor bzlas sbrags ma dang*/ 'og gi sna rtse'i sgom pa'ang yin la/ 'di las bde nyams che na 'dren bkram sogs kyang tshul bzhin bya'o// de ltar na lus dkyil ni rnam pa dbyibs kyi lha/ rdor bzlas 'bru gsum gyi rnam pa dang*/ ngo bo ni sngags kyi lha/ thig le dkar dmar gong bu'i lha/ de rnams dbyer mi phyed pa'i bde ba so so rang rig don dam ye shes kyi lha ste rim bzhin sku gsung thugs ye shes rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyis 'khor lo gsum yongs su rdzogs pa'i lhar sgrub pa yin no// gnad 'di sngon gyi grub pa ches mang po'i// thugs su gab mod mkhas mchog mang pos kyang*// yi ger bris pa bdag gis ma mthong na// grub pa'i dbang phyug don gyi mkhas pa'i gtso// bde chen rdo rje bdag skal yangs po la// bris bzhin ma sbas gsal por 'di na phye// zhes gsungs so// sgrub thabs 'dir 'bar 'dzag skabs/

ham̐ las byang sems babs/ des me lce gyen du bzlog par bsams zhes 'byung ba ni yig nor rgya 'byams su mngon te/ yig rnying du me yis byang sems bzlog par byed cing zhes gsungs pa ltar mas brten gyi dga' bzhi'i skabs la dgongs par nges so// de nas ngag rdo rje'i bzlas pa bya ste/ sgrub thabs kyi dngos brten dam tshig gi bzlas pa ltar du sgrub na/ ye shes sems dpa'i thugs khar nyi ma la hūm̐ dkar sngo 'dres ma dngul chu'i mdog can gyi mtha' mar/ oṃ shrī badzra he he sogs yab kyi snying po gnyis dang*/ nye snying yig bdun pa rnams sbrel ma kha dog mthing ga sbrul 'khyil ltar g.yon du bkod pa g.yas su 'khor ba la dmigs nas sngags sum sbrel grangs tshad long gi bar du bzla/ de nas yum gyi lte bar nyi ma la bam̐ dmar po/ sarba buddha sogs snying po dang*/ badzra bai ro sogs nye snying sbrel mas sbrul 'khyil du bskor ba g.yon du 'khor bar dmigs nas de la grangs tshad bsnyen cing*/ de nas 'khor bzlas la 'jug par/ dang por mdun gyi snang mdzad he ru ka'i thugs kar nyi ma la hūm̐ dkar po'i mtha' mar/ oṃ shrī buddha he he ru ru kaṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ zhes snying po snga mar badzra dang buddha'i sgyur kha dang*/ snying po phyi ma ḍā ki sogs spyi mthun las nye snying bor ba'i snying po de dag rang sbrel ma dkar po mgo mjug reg par ram sbrul 'khyil gang bder bskor ba la dmigs nas rnam snang he ru ka'i sngags grangs song rjes/ de'i yum mkha' 'gro ma'i thugs kar nyi mar māṃ mthing kar oṃ ḍā ki zhes mkha' 'gro ma nyid sngags kyis bskor ba g.yon 'khor la dmigs nas de dang*/ de bzhin lhag mar yang yab yum spel rim gyis sngags grangs gsog pa'i don grub he ru ka'i hūm̐ ljang khu/ snang mtha' he ru kar hūm̐ dmar po/ rin 'byung he ru kar hūm̐ ser po dang*/ yum gsum la lāṃ pāṃ tāṃ ljang dmar ser ba/

so so'i mthar sa bon rang mdog dang mtshungs pa'i sngags yab la g.yas dang yum la g.yon du 'khor ba ste/ don grub sogs bzhi la buddha'i tshab karma padma ratna rnams rim par bcug pa ma gtogs rnam snang ji lta ba dang*/ yum sngags lā ma sogs bzhi'i sngags sgrub thabs thun mong la grags pa ltar ro// grangs tshad ni gtso bo yab yum la bzhi 'bum/ rigs bzhi yab yum re re bzhin bzhi khri mdzad pa shas che la/ de'i rjes su yab yum gyi go cha rtsa sngags rnams kyang bzhi khri re bzla'o// spyir lus dkyil la phyi nang gi rnam gsal dag dran/ rdor bzlas bde stong gi nyams bskyang ba sogs gtso che yi ngag bzlas spyi mthun kho na gtso mi che zhes kyang gsungs so// dmigs pa ni/ sa bon sngags 'bru kun las 'od zer sna lnga sbrel stabs su 'phro bas so so'i thugs kar 'ja' gur phub pa ltar snang ba dang*/ gtso bo yab sngags bzla dus sngags sa bon dang bcas pa'i 'od zer sna lnga pa lus kyi sgo dang bu ga kun nas steng 'og phyogs mtshams khyab par spros pa 'dzam gling 'di'i yul chen nyer bzhi dur khrod brgyad sogs nas brtsams sprul sku'i zhing thams cad du song nas de dag tu sangs rgyas sras bcas 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par bzhugs pa phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod tshogs kyis mchod cing bskul bas mar me gcig las gnyis mched dam de dag nyid bzhengs nas 'byon pa'i tshul gang rung gis bsgoms pa ji lta ba'i phyi nang gi dkyil 'khor zung 'jug yongs rdzogs dang*/ lha tshogs gsil bu'i rnam par phyogs kun gang bar byon nas rten brten pa so so la so sor thim pa sngags skyes la zhing skyes bsre ba dang*/ yang sa bon sngags 'od kyis 'og min longs sku'i zhing bzhugs sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor mchod rjes rnam pa snga ma ltar spyan drangs nas thim pa zhing skyes la lhan skyes gzhug pa'i rim pa de'i mthus/

rang gi sgo gsum sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa las yongs su grol te/ lus snang sems gsum 'khor lo sdom pa rdo rje bzhi 'dus kyi dkyil 'khor chen por dag rdzogs brtan pas dngos grub rnam gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i sgo nas/ gzhan don byed mthu mtshungs med du gyur pa'i nga rgyal lhag par bskyed pa ni rang don dang 'brel ba pho nya gsum bsre'i dmigs pa'o// de nas sa bon sngags 'od sems can gyi khams khyab par spros pa'i klong nas chags bcas kyi sku bde mchog lha tshogs kyi rnam pa/ nang gses su las skal sna tshogs dang mthun pa'i rnam 'gyur can dang*/ chags bral shāka thub kyi rnam pa lta bu'i sangs rgyas 'khor dang bcas pa'i bkod pa sogs spros pa rnams kyis mdzad pa bcu gnyis lta bu'i sgo nas sems can gyi don spyad pa'i mod de khar sems can thams cad 'khor lo sdom par dag pas 'jig rten khams kun rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor chen por bsgyur rjes/ 'od zer tshur sdud pa ni gzhan don gyi dmigs pa'o// 'dir mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul ni chags bral la dga' ldan nas 'pho ba/ lhums su zhugs pa la sogs pa'i bkod pa yin pas/ bkod pa de 'dra res kyang sems can mtha' yas pa rnam grol du mdzad par bshad pa ltar 'dir yang ting nge 'dzin gyi skad cig gi bkod pa de 'dras sems can mang po he ru ka'i go 'phang du grol bar bsam pa ste/ sngon byung rnam sprul gyi khyad par rjes 'jug nyams len du byed pa 'dis kyang dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes kyi spyi ni dpal he ru ka dang*/ sangs rgyas thams cad he ru ka'i sprul par nges pa 'drongs pa la phan stobs chen por 'gyur zhing*/ de lta bu'i brda rtags don gyi he ru ka bdag gi spyod yul du mdzad nus pa'i bla ma ni he ru ka kho na las gzhan ma yin pas bla ma yi dam dbyer med de sangs rgyas kun bdag tu nges dgos pa ni gnad kyi dam pa yin pas dmigs pa de tsam gyi zur la yang zab gnad de 'dra ba yod par shes so// chags bcas kyi sku'i mdzad pa bcu gnyis ni/

las chen bcu gnyis dang*/ las bzhi grub pa brgyad dang bcas pas sam/ gzhan rgyud kyi 'khor ba'i rten 'brel bcu gnyis bcom pas gzhan don spyod pa sogs la bya'o// yum bzlas kyi skabs su yang don gnyis kyi dmigs pa de kha la pho nya spyan 'dren dang sems can lhar sbyong ba sogs kyi dus rnal 'byor ma nyid sogs lha mo'i rnam cha mang ba tsam dmigs zhes gsungs la/ yang pho sna mos 'dren pa dang*/ mo sna phos 'dren pa'i gnad kyis dmigs pa cha che chung go ldog tu byas kyang rung ngo*// rigs bzhi'i bzlas par gtso bo'i thugs kar sa bon la sngags 'phreng gis bskor ba sngar bzhin bsams nas/ pha rol gyi lha de de las 'od zer spro bar phyogs pa'i tshe/ bdag gi thugs 'od de'i sa bon sngags bcas la phog pas bskul te 'od spro ba yin pas na/ dang por rnam snang he ru ka'i thugs kar sa bon sngags phreng gsal btab pa bdag gi thugs 'od kyis bskul bas/ sa bon dang sngags las 'od zer dkar shas che ba sna lnga par 'phros pas sprul zhing rab 'byams kyi rgyal sras kun zhi ba'i las mthun gyi bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor du bzhugs pa las de'i mchod pas mchod nas/ 'khor lo yongs rdzogs dang gsil bu sna tshogs pa'i tshul gyis nam mkha' gang bar spyan drangs pa rnam snang he ru ka nyid gtso bor gyur pa'i dkyil 'khor kun la so sor bstim pa sngags zhing bsre ba dang*/ 'od kyis 'og min na he ru ka zhi ba'i dkyil 'khor du bzhugs pa mchod nas spyan drangs te bstim pa lhan skyes bsre ba ste/ bsre ba gsum mthus/ rang lus kyi dri ma dag nas he ru ka'i sku rdo rje ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor grub pas zhi ba'i las rab 'byams la mnga' brnyes pa'i sgo nas gzhan don sgrub nus su bsams te 'od zer rnam snang gi thugs kar bsdus zin las slar dngos grub kyi tshul du gtso bo'i thugs srog sngags bcas la thim par bsam/

de nas gzhan don gyi dmigs pa sngar bzhin la chags bral chags bcas gang gis kyang zhi ba'i 'phrin las kyi sgo nas don mdzad pa dang*/ sems can rnams kyang sku'i rigs kyi he ru kar dag pas zhi ba'i las 'grub nus su bsams nas 'od zer spro gzhi la bsdus rjes slar bdag la dngos grub tu thim pas/ sku rdo rje zhi ba'i 'phrin las dang 'brel ba'i rang don gzhan don gyi mnga' bdag tu gyur par bsam pa'i bskor 'ded dang*/ de'i yum bzlas la yang dmigs pa mtshungs par thugs ka nas 'od zer dngos grub kyi tshul du bstim pa tshun chad dgos so// don grub he ru kar yab yum la 'od zer ljang kha shas che ba'i sna lnga/ mchod yul dang mchod pa sna tshogs pa'i las mthun rang nyid kyi bya spyod sna tshogs dag pa dang*/ 'phrin las rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor grub pa/ las sna tshogs la mnga' brnyes/ gzhan don la 'di dang dbang gi las la chags bral gyi sku mi spro zhing*/ chags chen gyi skus las sna tshogs kyis gzhan don mdzad pa sems can las rigs kyi he ru kar gyur pa sogs bsgyur kha'o// de la las sna tshogs pa ni las bzhi 'dres ma yin pas 'di khongs nas gdug pa can tshar gcod pa yang thon pa'i phyir 'od zer gyi rtse mor bde mchog khams gsum rnam rgyal la sogs pa rdo rje'i khro tshogs kyang mang du spros pas drag sngags me mtshon sogs kyis dgra bgegs rnams bsgral nas rnam shes yum gyi mkha' dbyings su sbar bar bsam pa yang bya la mchod yul sna tshogs pa'i las mthun ni dkyil 'khor re'am lha re yang zhi rgyas drag dbang gi nyams kun dus gcig tshogs pa'am skad cig rer 'gyur ba sogs dang*/ kha dog kyang ljang khu ni gtso bo// gzhan cig la sna lnga tshang ba'am 'gyur ba can dang*/ dkar po sogs la'ang 'od zer ljang khu 'phro bas mtshon/ de bzhin zhi ba'i las mthun kyang dkar po shas che ba tsam ma gtogs/ ljang skya ser skya sngo skya sogs dang*/

sngon po dang dmar po la 'od zer dkar po 'bar ba lta bus dbang dang rgyas pa la yang shes pas/ rigs dang po'i bzlas par pho nya gsum bsre'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs par spyan 'dren pa'i tshe/ lha rang rang gi kha dog la skya shas che ba dang 'od dkar 'phro ba lta bu gtso bor byed cing*/ phyi nang gi dkyil 'khor pa kun zla ba'i mdog can du spyan 'dren pa sogs kyang rung bas gzhan 'gre'o// snang mtha' he ru ka yab yum la/ dmar shas che ba'i 'od lnga/ mchod yul mchod pa dbang gi las mthun/ ngag gi dri ma dag pa/ gsung rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor grub pa/ dbang gi las la mnga' brnyes rnams rang don dang*/ gzhan don la 'od zer gyi rtser he ru ka dbang gi lha spros pas khams gsum pa kun gyi snying khar lcags kyus btab ste/ dkyil 'khor gyi sgo dang phyogs phyogs su drangs pa rang dbang du gyur pas bskor zhing phyag byed pa gsol ba 'debs pa las/ de rnams kyi sems la 'pho med kyi bde ba'i byin chen po phebs pa'i mod der lus kyang 'ja' tshon du dwangs pa padma he ru ka'i go 'phang la gnas par bsam/ rin chen he ru ka yab yum la ser shas che ba'i 'od lnga/ rgyas pa'i las mthun gyi mchod lha sogs rang nyid kyi srid pa'i 'byor dpal der 'dzin bcas dag pa/ rin chen rigs kyi dkyil 'khor grub pa/ rgyas pa'i las la mnga' brnyes/ chags bral dang chags chen gyi sku spros pas rgyas pa'i las kyis gzhan don mdzad pa phyi rol du snod bcud kyi 'byor pa 'od kyis spel zhing*/ nang du sems can gyi tshe bsod lus mdangs bde ba ye shes kyi stobs spel ba'i mod der rin 'byung he ru ka'i dkyil 'khor du dag pa sogs so// yab yum kyi go cha bzla dus go cha'i lha so so'i thugs kar oṃ ha sogs ye shes rnams lha mdog dang mtshungs pa 'od zer sna lnga rang lus khyab par 'phro zhing 'bar bas sgo gsum gyi bar gcod dang khams kyi 'dzag pa bsrung zhing phung khams drug gi dri ma sbyangs nas rigs drug he ru ka'i go 'phang mngon du byed par bsam/

rtsa sngags bzla dus phal cher do lir mdzad pas ye shes sems dpa'i hūm̐ yig gi zhabs kyu nas oṃ na mo zhes thon pa dhū ti brgyud/ yab gsang nas yum gsang dang*/ de'i lte ba'i baṃ gyi dbus dang dhū ti brgyud zhal nas yab zhal dang*/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi nā da nas der 'jug par brtsam pa na/ hūm̐ zhabs nas sngags mtha' thon zin ma thag pa'i tshul du 'khor bar bsams nas bzla ba yin la/ dmigs pa sngar bshad gtso bo yab yum skabs kyi don gnyis spro bsdu kho na ste/ sa bon dang sngags 'phreng gi cha kun las 'od zer thon pas las de de byed par bsam/ yang na gtso bo'i thugs hūm̐ las rtsa sngags kyi sgra byung zhing de las 'od kyi spro bsdu yang byed pa tsam mo// yang gtso bo'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las yab sngags sum sbrel g.yas dang*/ yum sngags nyis sbrel g.yon phyogs nas thon pa gnyis gshibs sngar bshad ltar 'khor mos kyis/ yab yum sngags sbrel du grangs gsog rigs bzhi'i sngags kyang yab yum gnyis gshibs yab kyi sa bon las thon zhing 'khor tshul de ltar byed pa gtso 'khor gyi sngags do lir bzla ba'i lugs te/ dmigs pa ni gong bshad nyid la/ 'od spro tshul rtsa sngags skabs kyis shes/ go cha gnyis kyang gnyis gshibs gtso bo'i thugs hūm̐ nas thon pa'i do li byar rung la sngags 'od kyis lus khyab pas bar chad bsrungs pa sogs gong ltar ro// de ltar rnams ni bsnyen grangs gsog pa sogs dang 'brel zhing phyi dkyil dang thun mong ba'i sngags bzla tshul yin la/ khyad par ba gzhan ni 'di lta ste/ ye shes sems dpa'i thugs kar hūm̐ mthar nye snying yi ge bdun pa tsam bkod de g.yas su 'khor ba tsam dmigs pa'am/ yang na hūm̐ yig las yig bdun gyi sgra 'char ba tsam dmigs nas de nyid ngag tu bzla ba'am yid bzlas lta bu dmigs pa ye shes sems dpa' yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i dgyes nyams kyis lha mo bzhi po bskul zhing*/

bum thod kyi bdud rtsi rnams kyang bde 'phril ler 'khol ba dang*/ de dag gi mdangs sam nyams las lus gnas gzhan gyi lha yab yum rnams kyang mnyam sbyor gyi bde bas thugs rgyud gtams shing*/ sgo mtshams dang go cha'i lha yang dgyes bder spyod la/ de mthus phyi'i lha lnga bde nyams rgyas shing dkyil 'khor khang dur khrod rwa gur sogs snod kyi rnam cha kun kyang bde mer re ba dang*/ de la lus dkyil nas brtsams pa so so'i rnam cha dgyes nyams rol mo mdzad par gsal ba dbyibs kyi rnam 'byor rol mo mdzad pa'i sku lus kyi cha dang*/ byang sems 'bab 'dzeg gi 'gros las sngags sgra zi khol du 'char ba sngags kyi rnal 'byor/ byang sems 'bar 'dzag gi 'gros thig le'am gong bu'i rnal 'byor te/ 'di la ye shes sems dpa' yab yum la mkha' gsang rtser thig le dkar dmar dang*/ yab kyi spyi bor haṃ yig bsgoms pa dmar chas dkar cha bzhu brtul byed cing*/ dmar cha'i me zer dang dkar cha'i nyams kyis haṃ las byang sems yas brten du 'dren cing*/ slar mes ded tshul gyis mas brten bzhi 'gros sogs sngar rdor bzlas la dam tshig sems dpar ji ltar bsgoms pa de ltar mos dgos pa las/ snga ma la de skabs rlung dang sbyar ba'i spro bsdu'i rnam pa de 'dra ba 'dir mi dgos so// de ltar lus dkyil dang phyi'i lha bde ba chen pos dgyes pa rnams kyi thugs kar dang sbyor mtshams sogs sku lus kyi cha las bde ba'i reg pa can gyi 'od zer sna lnga pa spros pas yul chen nyer bzhi sogs sprul sku'i zhing bzhugs kyi 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor pa thams cad 'od las byung ba phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin gyis mchod cing bskul bas de kun bdag nyid bsgoms pa sngags kyis bskyed pa'i dkyil 'khor pa la thim pas zhing sngags gcig tu 'dres pa'i rkyen gyis bde ba'i ye shes lhag par 'bar zhing*/

slar yang de rnams kyi sku las 'od 'phros pas longs sku lhan skyes bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor mchod de spyan drangs nas phyi nang gi lhar bstim pas/ bde chen lhag par 'bar ba'i mthus nang du rtsa mdud rnams grol te rtsa thams cad dbu mar thim pas rnam bcas rdo rje'i gzugs mtha' klas rang 'char ba gzhan don 'gog med kyi sku thob/ rlung thams cad ye shes kyi rlung du gyur bas gzhom med sgra brnyan chos tshul thams cad pas gzhan don spyod pa'i gsung dang*/ rten thig le dwangs mar thim zhing*/ brten pa 'gyur bde 'pho ba'i bag chags dang bcas mi 'gyur ba'i ye shes su thim pas gzhan don thams cad pa'i 'byung gnas 'od gsal bde ba chen po rdo rje'i thugs te 'khor lo sdom pa'i rdo rje gsum du yongs su rdzogs pa yin no zhes dang*/ phyi rol du yang las snang thams cad he ru ka'i dkyil 'khor dag pa rab 'byams kyi snang bar 'phos shing*/ rim gyis snang ba'i cha yongs su zad nas phyi nang gnyis bral snang med bde ba chen po'i go 'phang grub pa yin snyam pa la sogs pa'i nga rgyal bskyed par bya ste don thob kyi 'bras bu yang de 'dra ba yin no// gzhan yang dmigs pa'i khyad par 'ga' re mchis mod 'dir mang du dogs pas ma bris so// bcu gnyis pa rdzogs rim ni/ ye shes sems dpa'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer sngon po 'phros pas/ dkyil 'khor las phyi rol du gyur pa'i snod bcud thams cad rten brten pa'i dkyil 'khor du sbyangs nas phyi ra gur nas brtsams pa'i gzhal yas khang la bsdu/ de rnams dbus kyi he ru ka lnga la bsdu/ he ru ka gzhan bzhi po gtso bo la bsdu/ gtso bo'i lus kyi dpa' mo nyer bzhi po spyi bo sogs rang rang gi gnas de der rang mdog dang mtshungs pa ste sngo dmar dkar ba so so ba'i 'od gur lta bu re sgom pa ni/ dpa' mo rnams rtsa'i dbyibs su skyong bar gyur pa'i mtshon byed dang*/

de rnams re re bzhin gyi dbus su byang thig re gsal 'debs pa ni/ dpa' bo rnams byang sems su gyur pas rtsa de rnams gang ba'i mtshon pa ste/ thugs 'khor ba rnams zhu ba'i thig le dkar la sngo mdangs chags pa/ gsung 'khor ba dkar la dmar mdangs chags pa/ sku 'khor ba shin tu dkar ba'i thig ler gyur pa'o// rtsa dang thig le de rnams kyang rang mdog dang mthun pa'i 'od du shig ger song ba'i 'od rnams cha gnyis su byas nas phyi ngos su sna sgo tshogs kyi sgo mtshams ma brgyad po dang*/ nang du snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi la thim/ phyi'i lha mo brgyad dang nang gi bzhi ste bcu gnyis po zhar byung mtshams kyi bum thod dang bcas pa snying ga'i gtso bo yab yum la bstim/ yum yab la/ de yas mas nas thugs ka'i hūm̐ nyi gdan dang bcas pa la/ nyi gdan hūm̐ la/ hūm̐yang zhabs kyu nas nā da'i bar dang de yang mi dmigs pa stong nyid du yal bar bsams pas/ phyi'i lhan skyes kyi sku gcig po tsam lus par gyur la/ de'i yang lus kyi cha oṃ/ ngag āḥ yid hūm̐ du gyur pas de gsum steng 'og tu brtsegs pa'i 'og gi oṃ āḥl/ de hūm̐ la/ de yang je chung je phrar yal bar bsams nas mnyam par bzhag slar thun mtshams kyi he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis par ldang ba dang dge bsngo bya'o// rjes ni gzhan las shes par bya ste gtor ma'i rnal 'byor la sogs pa'o// brten g.yo'i rnam pa 'char bzhin pa 'di med snang ste// 'di bsal shul du dag snang rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor 'byams// mthar gtugs pa na dag pa'i snang ba'ang snang med kyi// bde chen yab yum zung 'jug ngang du ye grol lo// de ltar rtogs byed thabs mang po'i// nang na zab mo lus dkyil du// sgrub thabs khyad 'phags reg zig ste// shin tu snying por dril 'di sbyar/ dngos grub yod/ a la la ho/ zhes mañdzu shrīs so/// /
